name: SERPpro API
description:
Programmatic access to the SERPpro link-building platform: browse the publisher marketplace, place orders, check balance, find PR opportunities, generate AI pitches, and run SEO analyses.

**Designed for ChatGPT Custom GPT Actions, Zapier, n8n, Make, and any HTTP client.**

Fallback base URL (if the Cloudflare proxy is unavailable): https://vzyinpfiextyelxpmnnu.supabase.co/functions/v1/api-v1
